tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Lifting Criterion] 1. chA:A.56[LeeTM, Thm. 11.18] Suppose $\pi : \tilde{M} \to M$ is a covering map, $B$ is a connected and locally path-connected topological space, and $F: B \to M$ is a continuous map. Given $b \in B$ and $\tilde{x} \in \tilde{M}$ such that $\pi (\tilde{x}) = F(b)$, the map $F$ has a lift to $\tilde{M}$ if and only if $F_*(\pi _1(B,b)) \subseteq \pi _*(\pi _1(\tilde{M}, \tilde{x}))$.
